name: Handoff
description: Connect Claude to your Handoff account to manage construction work in plain English. Find or create projects and contacts, build and update estimates, manage proposals and invoices, and work with files, expenses, daily logs, schedules, and time entries. Confirmed actions can also send documents or delete records. Access stays scoped to the Handoff account you authorize.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Handoff to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Handoff to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.handoff.ai/core/api/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Handoff MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handoff provides these MCP tools: handoff_action, handoff_read, and handoff_write.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Handoff?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Handoff in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Handoff requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Handoff is developed by Handoff. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
